name: The Elder Scrolls: Betrayal of the Second Era

categories.label: Campaign won (endgame completed)
categories.hint: Win by completing the final endgame session; failing any guild quest step or the 12-day limit ends the campaign in defeat.

categories.label: Sessions completed
categories.hint: Guild quest sessions succeeded, including the endgame session.

winCondition: Cooperative campaign of sessions: each session ends when the party succeeds or fails its guild quest (fail any step or exceed day 12 = campaign lost). After the second session, play the endgame session; completing it wins the campaign. Guild assist can be used once per campaign in sessions 1-2 only.

endCondition.description: Session ends on guild quest success or failure; campaign ends on endgame success or failure

notes: family: coop. No points; campaign legacy state (XP, journal, keywords) is not modelled. Rules text taken from a rulebook transcription (RulesPal), not the original PDF.
